newsitem.title: UK: RTZ shares up after UBS upgrades to "hold".
newsitem.headline: RTZ shares up after UBS upgrades to "hold".

text.p: Shares in RTZ Corp Plc rose on Thursday after UBS upgraded the mining group to "hold" from "sell", traders said.
The stock was up 14p at 896-1/2p by 1340 GMT, after on Wednesday touching a one-year low of 882-1/2.

Martin Bomford, mining analyst at UBS, said he thought the stock represented fair value given its recent declines and his view of the company's prospects. UBS had previously set a price level of 880p as a fair value for the stock.
"It's been said that 880 is a key chart level and they've bounced off it," one market-maker said.
